coverage.purpose: Priority review inventory, not exhaustive regulatory mapping or completed expert review.
unreviewed: Independent human review of all entries

items.scope: Qualify each software/module by intended purpose and applicable jurisdiction before assigning device or IEC software safety classifications. EU device risk class and IEC software safety class are different decisions.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2017/745
sources.locator: Article 2(1); Annex VIII 3.1, 3.3, Rule 11 and other applicable rules

items.scope: The tooling never assigns a default safety class. IEC 62304 4.3 g) applies class C requirements until classification; the responsible person must resolve this obligation and the tool's undecided state, not treat a warning as exemption.

Software-implemented risk control requirements are included in requirements to the extent appropriate; this clause's class applicability is B/C. This does not exempt class A from device risk management.
Re-evaluate the medical-device risk analysis when software requirements are established and update it as appropriate.

Architecture and architecture verification in 5.3.1-.4/.6 apply B/C; risk-dependent segregation in 5.3.5 is C. Unit subdivision 5.4.1 is B/C; detailed unit/interface design and its verification 5.4.2-.4 are C. Stronger project documentation can be planned without mislabelling it a class-A standard obligation.
Implement every selected risk control and verify its implementation. Keep the evidence distinct from the claim that the control reduces risk effectively.

Verify each risk control's effectiveness, recording results in the risk management file. One suitable activity may support implementation and effectiveness, but both claims need evidence. Separate physical records are not a universal additional ISO requirement.

Evaluate individual residual risk against planned criteria; consider more controls if unacceptable. Where additional control is impracticable, benefit-risk evaluation needs supporting data and human evaluation. Do not substitute an acceptable calculated band, overall review or business benefit for this disposition.

sources.title: ISO 14971
sources.locator: 7.3, 7.4; overall residual risk under clause 8 is a separate activity

items.scope: A/B/C require direct signatures on each verification result by a named human independent of the author/builder, competence established by the QMS, and established Part 11 surrounding-system controls/intended-use validation. A report cannot substitute. This is stricter repository policy, not an IEC 62304 per-test-signature mandate or universal legal-applicability claim. The shipped backend cannot authenticate that system, so verification acceptance and product release remain held.

sources.title: IEC 62304
sources.locator: 5.1.6 and applicable verification clauses; repository policy adds the per-result signing rule

items.scope: Complete and evaluate software verification before release (all classes), document anomalies (all), assess their unacceptable-risk implications under 5.8.3 (B/C), identify the version and preserve/deliver the configuration under the applicable clauses. A green structural check is not a human release decision or product verification.

For software used in an ISO 13485 QMS, document validation procedures, validate before first use and revalidate as appropriate after software/application changes. The approach is proportionate to risk of use. A package version, passing unit suite or declared boolean does not validate an adopting organisation's intended use.

Competence rests on relevant education, training, skills and experience with retained supporting evidence. A CV supports competence but does not demonstrate that a named reviewer assessed this revision or provide independent review of their own work.

sources.title: ISO 13485
sources.locator: 6.2; version-bound independent review is the repository's assurance practice

items.scope: Assess legal applicability separately from universal A/B/C repository policy requiring established Part 11 surrounding-system controls/intended-use validation and QMS-established competence. Review actual identity, authority, signature meaning/revision binding, audit trails, integrity, corrections, retention and retrieval. Hashes, names, tags and assessment declarations alone do not establish those controls; unestablished controls hold verification acceptance/release. No system-compliance claim is made for this library or its GitHub reference.
